thread:
Mike (AE): quick handoff for SummitBank — closed-won last week. They signed 12-month Dedicated contract, go-live planned in 3 weeks. Key risks: SSO failing in staging, slow embeddings on large docs, and low pilot user count (only 2 power users so far). Renewal window in 10 months. :calendar:
Sarah (CSM): thanks — I'm owning onboarding. current checklist: SSO, data access, training plan, telemetry. tagging low adoption as 'risk-medium'. can you drop context on SSO issues?
Mike (AE): SSO error is a SAML mismatch — customer sees "invalid audience" in IdP logs. They supplied metadata; our staging connector rejects assertion. Also mentioned embeddings inference ~3-4x slower than prod during bulk tests. they ran ~10k-doc batch.
Priya (Solutions Eng): assigning myself to SSO debug first. please DM me the raw IdP metadata and assertion examples. For embeddings, can you share model + config (quantized?), batch size, and region?
Mike (AE): metadata sent in DM. embeddings config: model: text-embed-3-small, quantized: yes, batch_size: 64, region: us-east-1-dedicated, core_count: 4. customer pulled logs showing timeouts around 60s.
Sarah (CSM): next steps I propose: 1) Priya to validate SAML config with customer tomorrow 0900-1000 ET (owner: Priya). 2) Anita (Support) to collect embeddings perf logs & escalate if perf regression (owner: Anita). 3) Dave (Eng) to triage runtime perf if logs show CPU/GPU saturation (owner: Dave). 4) CSM will run a 1-week adoption playbook and provide enablement sessions (owner: Sarah).
Anita (Support): acknowledged. I'll capture logs, sample request/response headers, and kernel metrics. If we see queuing on the GPU, will open a P1 ticket and tag @dave.eng.
Dave (Eng Lead): noted. if it's quantization/regression we may need a quick rollback to previous backend or bump instance size. ETA for initial triage 24h after Anita uploads logs.
oncall-bot: incident create - auto-ticket #INC-2026 created for embeddings perf with priority P2 (will be updated by support).
Sarah (CSM): customer ask: can we provision a short-term burst pool during onboarding to smooth UX? Mike — confirm commercial OK?
Mike (AE): yes — 2-week burst approved from sales side. I'll update the contract addendum.
Priya (Solutions Eng): SSO action: please try this quick validation snippet on staging IdP -> assertion to our ACS URL and paste results:
```
curl -v -X POST https://staging.redwood.example.com/sso/assert -d "SAMLResponse=<base64>" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
```
If you get 400 with "invalid audience", send full response headers.
Sarah (CSM): tagging owners in summary: Priya (SSO validation, tom 09:00ET), Anita (collect perf + upload, today EOD), Dave (triage if infra saturating, within 24h of logs), Mike (contract addendum + burst pool), Sarah (adoption playbook + enablement). I'll run a sync on Monday 10:30ET with all parties and the customer.
Anita (Support): uploading logs to #case-4532 now. link: https://files.redwood/summitbank/logs/4532. set to private.
Dave (Eng Lead): saw the logs — GPU memory looks fine but queue depth spikes correlate with large batches. I'll try simulating 10k-doc workload in a mirror env and report findings by EOD tomorrow.
Sarah (CSM): customer feedback note: they love the Console dashboards but want clearer batching recommendations for embeddings. I'll capture suggested doc-level prompts and surface to Product.
Mike (AE): one more: renewal risk currently low but will mark 'watch' until adoption >10 users or weekly active >= 50. Sarah, please flag if not trending up in 6 weeks.
Sarah (CSM): will do. thanks everyone — will post meeting invite and follow-up notes after Monday sync. :thumbsup:
